Sreesanth's 3-year ban lifted by KCA after unconditional apology

The Kerala Cricket Association (KCA) has removed the three-year ban imposed on cricketer S. Sreesanth. The decision follows an unconditional apology submitted by the player. This action allows Sreesanth to potentially resume his cricketing career.
